label: Historical replay over a named period. Not a forecast, not a probability.

method.window: A position opened at the close of an hour and left alone for the horizon. Every start hour whose window all the rate series cover (stride 1h).
method.membrane: One traced stressGrid runStress replay per window, the same replay and case as the survival table (set-and-forget-ltv.json); the trace times each recall draw.
method.incumbent: compare.ts runIncumbent on the same replay: the same collateral and start debt on Aave v3.
method.yieldEarned: Venue supply APR (net-APY history, sample-and-hold) × the debt still deployed, simple interest. Membrane: priced at its whole book at the venue (the preset’s book; the floor names none, so the default $50M book); the gross venue yield before Membrane’s curator-set share, so an upper bound on what reaches the user. Aave: priced at the position’s own deposit.
method.borrowCost: Aave: the measured hourly variable borrow APR × the debt still owed. Membrane: unavailable (curator-set share of yield; deployed debt carries no interest).
method.collateralSold: Membrane: the engine’s exposedUsd (fees omitted; a sale in the held tail after the horizon counts, as in the survival table). Aave: seized collateral incl. the liquidation bonus.
method.yieldGivenUp: Membrane: what the capital the recalls drew would have earned for the rest of the window. Aave: 0 by construction (no recall).
method.summary: Quantiles (lower nearest rank) over the n windows of the named period. History, not odds.

notModelled: Membrane’s curator-set share of the yield (never priced pre-launch)
Membrane’s liquidation fee and the fee on a recall cure (LiquidationEngine STEP 2.5): the Membrane sold figure is understated

an Aave liquidation needs a liquidator in that half hour: modelled as always present
